audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleed: verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under titles ('Call the root on his cooldown', 'Waste R answering poke') that promise different, more specific content.
audit.why: The reader expects dosFull[1] to explain root timing against Corki specifically and dontsFull[2] to explain the R-waste mechanic, not repeat the generic trading rule already on the page.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now names Valkyrie's real cooldown window (20/18/16/14/12s) as the root trigger. dontsFull[2].d now explains Corki's R has only a 2s recharge between missiles, so R-dodging isolated poke wastes Featherstorm before the real all-in arrives.

audit.why: Level 3 root vs. Valkyrie escape, level 6 Featherstorm dodging Missile Barrage, and the first-item burst race are all named with correct timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentions that Hextech Munitions (Corki's P) converts a percentage of his auto damage to true damage, bypassing armor entirely.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags this as applicable and unmentioned; a player stacking armor against his autos would be spending gold on the wrong stat.
audit.corrected: Not added to a writable field this pass — no clean short slot without exceeding the field-touch/length limits for this matchup; recorded here for the itemization pass.

edits.before: Q the line, W-trade three autos, E the disengage — the bill roots him on the floor he ignored.
edits.after: Valkyrie is on a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown — once he's burned it, the E root lands clean and he has no dash to answer with.

edits.before: Calling two feathers out of impatience — the root needs three; early calls are confetti.
edits.after: His R recharges a missile every 2s — dodging one poke shot with Featherstorm wastes your reset long before his real barrage arrives.

edits.before: - Corki R The Big One: matchup-defining — His Big One barrage flips river fights — track the missile windows like an objective. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Featherstorm like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Corki's R stores missiles on a 2s recharge, with every 3rd shot a Big One — track the stack count, not a single cooldown. - Valkyrie is down for 20/18/16/14/12s after use — that's your root window. - Guard Featherstorm for kill windows only.

notes: wants.you[0]/early's 'Seed Double Daggers feathers' flagged by the linter's suspectNames is a false positive — Double Daggers is the correct name for Xayah's own Q, not an enemy ability. True-damage passive (Hextech Munitions) note deferred per audit point 13 above — worth a short itemization addendum in a follow-up pass ('armor alone doesn't stop his autos').
